subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding prefixes, suffixes or both with the root words given in the parenthesis:
stimulus: 0.5 x 10=5 Money occupies a unique position in our modern (a) ____ (capital) economy. In its (b) ____ (absent), the whole (c) ____ (prosper) economic life would collapse like a packet of cards. Money is used as a medium of (d) ____ (change). It promotes (e) ____(specialise) which increases (f) ____ (product) and efficiency. But money cannot buy (g) ____ (happy). Money is a must for our life. But it is not necessary to bring happiness. Happiness is (h) ____ (absolute) a psychological thing. It is the name of a feeling. It means the (i) ____(content) of the mind. He who has (j) ____ (satisfy) with what he has is really a happy one.
guide_solution: (a) capitalist (b) absence (c) prosperous (d) exchange (e) specialization (f) production (g) happiness (h) absolutely (i) contentment (j) satisfied
